1: import type { IterationNode, Node, NonterminalNode } from "ohm-js";
2: 
3: import type { Expr, Stmt } from "../ast";
4: import { type ParserActionDict, spanOf } from "./_shared";
5: 
6: /* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-call */
7: 
8: function parseParams(paramsOpt: IterationNode): readonly string[] {
9:   if (paramsOpt.children.length > 0) {
10:     return paramsOpt.children[0]!.toAst() as string[];
11:   }
12:   return [];
13: }
14: 
15: export const functionActions: ParserActionDict = {
16:   FunDef(
17:     this: NonterminalNode,
18:     _funKw: Node,
19:     identNode: Node,
20:     _lp: Node,
21:     _nlOpen: IterationNode,
22:     paramsOpt: IterationNode,
23:     _nlClose: IterationNode,
24:     _rp: Node,
25:     _nl: Node,
26:     block: Node,
27:     _endKw: Node,
28:   ): Stmt {
29:     return {
30:       kind: "FunDef" as const,
31:       span: spanOf(this),
32:       name: identNode.toAst() as string,
33:       params: parseParams(paramsOpt),
34:       body: block.toAst() as Stmt[],
35:     };
36:   },
37: 
38:   PrimaryExp_anonFun_expr(
39:     this: NonterminalNode,
40:     _funKw: Node,
41:     _lp: Node,
42:     _nlOpen: IterationNode,
43:     paramsOpt: IterationNode,
44:     _nlClose: IterationNode,
45:     _rp: Node,
46:     body: Node,
47:   ): Expr {
48:     return {
49:       kind: "AnonFunExpr" as const,
50:       span: spanOf(this),
51:       params: parseParams(paramsOpt),
52:       body: body.toAst() as Expr,
53:     };
54:   },
55: 
56:   PrimaryExp_anonFun_block(
57:     this: NonterminalNode,
58:     _funKw: Node,
59:     _lp: Node,
60:     _nlOpen: IterationNode,
61:     paramsOpt: IterationNode,
62:     _nlClose: IterationNode,
63:     _rp: Node,
64:     _nl: Node,
65:     block: Node,
66:     _endKw: Node,
67:   ): Expr {
68:     return {
69:       kind: "AnonFunBlock" as const,
70:       span: spanOf(this),
71:       params: parseParams(paramsOpt),
72:       body: block.toAst() as Stmt[],
73:     };
74:   },
75: };
